description: Bounded listing of joseki run rows, optionally filtered by status (running/awaiting_user/completed/failed) and/or joseki_key, newest first up to limit (default 50). Each row uses the same projection as get_joseki_run.
embedding_description: List recent platform-driven joseki runs across all cards: which joseki executions are currently running, which parked awaiting a user, which completed or failed — filterable by run status or by one card's JOSEKI_KEY. The fleet-level run dashboard read. Distinct from get_joseki_run (one run by id) and list_playbooks or list_plans (planning artifacts, not joseki executions).
